title: Phase 1 — Executable Repository Foundation
prerequisites: Phase 0 independent architecture review is PASS_WITH_RESIDUAL_WORK with no open P0/P1 ownership conflict.
The machine-readable schema inventory and first-slice examples exist and validate.
Implementation begins from the exact baseline commit or an explicitly rebased approved baseline.
Every suboperation uses a short-lived branch/PR and its own Evidence.
objectives: Create a reproducible strict TypeScript monorepo that builds from a clean checkout.
Establish runtime-validated Contract and schema infrastructure.
Enforce package dependency direction and unique authority ownership.
Qualify the accepted toolchain, node:sqlite, Control API, PROCESS_RESTRICTED and Policy decisions.
Produce a self-contained Windows-first qualification artifact and release evidence.
Provide a repository foundation on which Phase 2 can implement the durable Kernel without hidden technical decisions.
nonGoals: Do not implement production Workflow, Node Runtime, Router, Scheduler or terminal transitions.
Do not implement production Verification System, EvidenceGraph or Learning runtime.
Do not connect real models, tools, GBrain or private Workspaces.
Do not implement OS_SANDBOXED, Human Approval lifecycle or remote execution.
Do not claim a production-ready installer or complete Framework.
Do not migrate or copy old local Framework source.

suboperations.title: Toolchain and reproducible monorepo foundation
outputs: Exact toolchain manifest and frozen lockfile

suboperations.title: Deterministic Policy compiler and evaluator qualification
Authenticated loopback Control API and lifecycle qualification
Self-contained qualification release and supply-chain baseline

stopConditions: An accepted ADR cannot be implemented as specified or qualification contradicts its safety/correctness claims.
Any required change falls outside the current operation WRITE_SCOPE.
A second authority implementation, fallback driver/transport/evaluator or silent isolation downgrade appears necessary.
A public or persisted Contract has ambiguous owner, incompatible fields or cannot be runtime-validated.
A required R4 verification step is unavailable, skipped or inconclusive.
Secrets/private local data would need to enter the repository or GitHub workflow.
Clean Windows/Linux build, local API exposure control or process-tree containment cannot be demonstrated.
Repository baseline changes concurrently and invalidates Evidence or path scope.
completionCriteria: All P1-O01 through P1-O09 outputs exist and their required verification steps have Evidence.
The repository builds and validates from a clean checkout with the exact accepted toolchain.
Architecture checks prevent dependency inversion, deep imports, cycles and duplicate authority ownership.
All accepted ADR qualification obligations are either PASS or explicitly BLOCKED; no unauthorized fallback is used.
A self-contained Windows qualification artifact starts without local development tools and does not write outside its test data root.
The implementation receipt validates against receipt.schema.json and declares at most IMPLEMENTED.
An independent verifier can reproduce the Gate using public scripts and recorded environment facts.
declarationRules: The implementation Agent may declare IMPLEMENTED, PARTIAL or BLOCKED.
The implementation Agent must not declare VERIFIED.
Each suboperation records actual commands, environment, commit, results, Evidence and known gaps.
Skipped, unavailable and inconclusive results remain visible and cannot be converted to PASS.
Independent verification occurs after implementation on an immutable commit without remediation in the same pass.
